sentences.en: Sami threw a peace and reconciliation barbecue at his home.
sentences.zh: 萨米在他家举办了一场和平与和解烧烤聚会。

sentences.en: The reconciliation report was issued in violation of the legislative requirements.
sentences.zh: 这份和解报告是在违反立法要求的情况下发布的。

sentences.en: Reconciliation among religions is the foundation of world peace.
sentences.zh: 各种宗教之间的和解是世界和平的基础。

senses.zh: 和解，调停；一致；服从，顺从
